gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.title: Owner fee comparison guide
gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.summary: A current comparison of published Airbnb host fees, Stripe card-processing pricing, and the property-specific management quote an owner should request before signing or renewing.
gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.sourceLabel: Airbnb host fees and Stripe pricing

sources.label: Airbnb service fees for home hosts

gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.sourceNote: Platform commission, card processing, and full-service management cover different services and are not all-in equivalents.
gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.retirementReason: The earlier Seascape portfolio figures passed their freshness window and do not have an approved public-use receipt. Keep them out of public copy unless a new privacy-safe receipt is explicitly approved.
antiClaims: Do not present expired portfolio totals as current performance.
Do not claim that direct booking automatically raises owner payout.
Do not compare platform commission with card processing as all-in equivalents.
Do not expose owner names, internal file paths, or private booking records.
gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.methodology: This guide uses Airbnb's and Stripe's published pricing pages. Seascape management pricing is property-specific and controlled by the signed management agreement.
